test_title: SSC MTS 2023 Official Paper (Held On: 06 Sept, 2023 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Identify the INCORRECTLY spelt word in the following sentence and select its correct spelling from the given options.

He has neither the policies nor the persanol charisma to inspire people.
solution:
The correct answer is: **personal**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word** **"persanol" is incorrectly spelt and should be **"personal"**.
 
• **"Personal"** refers to something private or individual, related to a specific person. (व्यक्तिगत)
 
 
• **Example:** She keeps her personal diary locked in a drawer.
 
 

Therefore, the correct answer is: **Option 3** i.e. **personal**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences:

 
• **cherisma** (आकर्षण): Incorrect spelling of "charisma".

 
 
• **Example:** His charisma made him a popular leader.
 
 
 
• **polecies** (नीतियाँ): Incorrect spelling of "policies".
 
 
• **Example:** The company's policies were updated last year.
 
 
 
• **niether** (न तो): Incorrect spelling of "neither".
 
 
• **Example:** Neither of the two options was suitable.
